row.proto: const char *Loc_LangSet_Find(void *set, const char *key, int32_t mode)
row.notes: vt_Loc_LangSet (0x1458a8890) slot +0x08, the localised string lookup: takes the set's recursive lock (+0x68), walks the priority-sorted table list (+0x38 .. sentinel +0x30) and returns the first table->vt+0x08(table, key, mode) hit (UTF-8, owned by the table), or null. The set's other lookups (slots +0x10/+0x18/+0x20: copy into a buffer or NeStr, missing-tag formatting through +0x28) call it through the vtable, so every lng_* lookup reaches it. Registered by native-1990 for the core runtime string overrides (feat/lang-override); map in f1-modding re/db/subsystems/loc.md.
